object_description: three-storey rectangular building tapering slightly toward its ends
design_condition: Located at the edge of the school complex between existing trees, the compact building preserves valuable planting and much of the southern open space while adding play areas around its ends.

positive.statement: The compact placement preserves valuable trees and half of the existing playground.
The building’s height and volume are conceivable as a further development of the complex.
Large windows provide views of greenery and a maximum connection to the outside space.
The clear spatial division and restrained materialization create spatial quality.
The project fulfills the spatial program well and uses volumes and areas economically.
The compact volume has a correspondingly low building envelope.
The structure and facade grid enable flexible use.

negative.statement: The resulting building form and setting appear random and interchangeable.
The appearance feels somewhat cold and anonymous beside the existing school complex.
The outside-space design is only faintly visible.
The grid creates elongated rooms with unfavorable aspect ratios.
Access through the cloakroom creates cramped situations, and the wet zones are not optimally solved operationally.
The route to music and support spaces is too long for daily use.
The support-center layout is not operationally optimal.
Standardization subordinates the auditorium, whose room height is too tight.
The auditorium escape-route situation is unresolved, and fire compartments are not sufficiently evident.
